name: {s}Speak with Brother Mhenlo in Bukdek Byway.

Are you Meow Zu Heltzer? Listen, a bunch of other foreigners just left for <c=@Quest>Bukdek Byway.</c> They said they were going to go look for someone named Master Togo. One of them, <c=@Quest>Mhenlo</c>, I think he said his name was, left a message for you to meet up with them. He was a nice enough fellow, but I was a little distracted by that sassy little blonde he had with him.

Reward:<brx>3,000 Experience<brx>150 Gold<brx>1 Skill Point<brx>

You must be the foreign recruits Kormir told me to expect. It's good to see so many heroes from beyond these shores coming to our aid. <c=@Quest>Spearmarshal Kormir</c> is waiting for you in the <c=@Quest>Plains of Jarin</c>. You should hurry and catch up to her; she seems even more driven than normal these days and probably won't wait around long.

Reward:<brx>1,500 Experience<brx>15 Sunspear Promotion Points<brx>Battle Commendation<brx>
{s}Find and destroy Krak Flamewhip's elite cavalry unit in Jaga Moraine.

<c=@Quest>Krak Flamewhip</c>, a notoriously cruel Stone Summit Dwarf, has mobilized a mounted unit that has been wreakin' havoc on us Deldrimor. He and his stooges have been sighted in <c=@Quest>Jaga Moraine</c>. You'd be doin' us a heck of a favor if ya put a <c=@Quest>hurtin'</c> on 'em.

Reward:<brx>200 Dwarf reputation points<brx>1,000 Gold<brx>"Don't Trip!"<brx>
{s}Enter the tournament and defeat your first round opponent.

[Solo Quest] I laugh at heroes. I scoff at dragons. I even deride the Titans! None have withstood my strong right arm. None have bested Magni the Bison. This tournament will decide who has the right to challenge me.

You have something of a reputation among the other weaklings. But you will still need to defeat five opponents in my tournament before earning the right to face me, your sixth and final challenge! Reward:150 Norn reputation pointsA Touch of Guile"Dodge This!""Finish Him!"The Bison Cup

description.decoded:
<c=@warning>[Solo Quest]</c> I've been training with these Norn to learn the ways of brass-knuckle <c=@Quest>brawling</c>. I gotta say, them big fellas can fight! To them, you're nothing but a <c=@Quest>clown</c>. But I'll teach ya what I've learned so you can jump in the ring and tangle with the best of 'em. Here, take these <c=@Quest>brass knuckles</c> and crack a few skulls. It's good for the constitution!

Reward:<brx>100 Dwarf reputation points<brx>Brawling Headbutt<brx>

description.decoded:
I got myself a giant problem, friend. I came all the way from Deldrimor because Budger Blackpowder needed to extract some tricky ore for his high quality explosives. But no sooner than I set up operations did a <c=@Quest>jotun clan</c> move in and slaughter most of our workers. The rest of our miners won't go near the site. You might not know this, but we Dwarves don't much like jotun. Nasty customers with big clubs. Do me and Budger a favor, would you? Go remove the jotun clan leader, <c=@Quest>Ulgrimar Gnash</c> and all of his Dwarf-busting buddies so we can start mining again.

Reward:<brx>100 Dwarf reputation points<brx>1,000 Gold<brx>Dwarven Stability<brx>Snow Storm<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Find and kill Chieftain Ulgrimar Gnash in Drakkar Lake.

[Solo Quest] I laugh at heroes. I scoff at dragons. I even deride the Titans! None have withstood my strong right arm. None have bested Magni the Bison. This tournament will decide who has the right to challenge me.

You have something of a reputation among the other weaklings. But you will still need to defeat five opponents in my tournament before earning the right to face me, your sixth and final challenge! Reward:150 Norn reputation pointsA Touch of Guile"Dodge This!""Finish Him!"The Bison Cup

objectives.decoded: {s}Enter the tournament and defeat your first round opponent.

description.decoded:
Are you Meow Zu Heltzer? Listen, a bunch of other foreigners just left for <c=@Quest>Bukdek Byway.</c> They said they were going to go look for someone named Master Togo. One of them, <c=@Quest>Mhenlo</c>, I think he said his name was, left a message for you to meet up with them. He was a nice enough fellow, but I was a little distracted by that sassy little blonde he had with him.

Reward:<brx>3,000 Experience<brx>150 Gold<brx>1 Skill Point<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Speak with Brother Mhenlo in Bukdek Byway.

description.decoded:
You must be the foreign recruits Kormir told me to expect. It's good to see so many heroes from beyond these shores coming to our aid. <c=@Quest>Spearmarshal Kormir</c> is waiting for you in the <c=@Quest>Plains of Jarin</c>. You should hurry and catch up to her; she seems even more driven than normal these days and probably won't wait around long.

Reward:<brx>1,500 Experience<brx>15 Sunspear Promotion Points<brx>Battle Commendation<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Talk to Kormir.

description.decoded:
<c=@Quest>Krak Flamewhip</c>, a notoriously cruel Stone Summit Dwarf, has mobilized a mounted unit that has been wreakin' havoc on us Deldrimor. He and his stooges have been sighted in <c=@Quest>Jaga Moraine</c>. You'd be doin' us a heck of a favor if ya put a <c=@Quest>hurtin'</c> on 'em.

Reward:<brx>200 Dwarf reputation points<brx>1,000 Gold<brx>"Don't Trip!"<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Find and destroy Krak Flamewhip's elite cavalry unit in Jaga Moraine.

description.decoded:
<c=@warning>[Solo Quest]</c> I've been training with these Norn to learn the ways of brass-knuckle <c=@Quest>brawling</c>. I gotta say, them big fellas can fight! To them, you're nothing but a <c=@Quest>clown</c>. But I'll teach ya what I've learned so you can jump in the ring and tangle with the best of 'em. Here, take these <c=@Quest>brass knuckles</c> and crack a few skulls. It's good for the constitution!

Reward:<brx>100 Dwarf reputation points<brx>Brawling Headbutt<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Speak to Kilroy to start your brawling training.

description.decoded:
I got myself a giant problem, friend. I came all the way from Deldrimor because Budger Blackpowder needed to extract some tricky ore for his high quality explosives. But no sooner than I set up operations did a <c=@Quest>jotun clan</c> move in and slaughter most of our workers. The rest of our miners won't go near the site. You might not know this, but we Dwarves don't much like jotun. Nasty customers with big clubs. Do me and Budger a favor, would you? Go remove the jotun clan leader, <c=@Quest>Ulgrimar Gnash</c> and all of his Dwarf-busting buddies so we can start mining again.

Reward:<brx>100 Dwarf reputation points<brx>1,000 Gold<brx>Dwarven Stability<brx>Snow Storm<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Find and kill Chieftain Ulgrimar Gnash in Drakkar Lake.
